objective: Validate whether authenticated REST telemetry/attribute POST endpoints using @RequestBody String can bypass the default Content-Length-only payload guard with Transfer-Encoding: chunked and cause target JVM memory exhaustion.

static_hypothesis.guard: server.http.max_payload_size default includes /api/**=16777216 and PayloadSizeFilter checks request.getContentLength().
static_hypothesis.sink: TelemetryController.saveAttributes/saveTelemetry materializes @RequestBody String, parses it with JsonParser.parseString, and converts JSON entries into in-memory lists before asynchronous save.
static_hypothesis.attacker_control: Authenticated body byte volume and JSON key/value count using Transfer-Encoding: chunked without Content-Length.

data_preparation_plan: Use documented default Tenant Administrator credentials tenant@thingsboard.org / tenant.
Create a disposable test device via POST /api/device.
Use the Tenant Administrator JWT for low-privilege authenticated REST POST probes.
Delete the test device after probe if the service remains available; otherwise remove the disposable container and data directory.

probe_plan.control: POST 17 MiB JSON with Content-Length to confirm PayloadSizeFilter rejects or closes early at /api/**=16 MiB.
probe_plan.attack: POST chunked JSON without Content-Length to /api/plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/{deviceId}/SERVER_SCOPE.
probe_plan.actual_stop: Stopped after 256 MiB chunked request because target JVM logged OutOfMemoryError and HTTP availability failed.
